'''SoapBox Stream''' is the streaming vertical of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem, published at stream.soapbox.community. It is a catalog-and-player surface that sources '''only''' free, legally-clear video.

== What it streams ==
* '''Public-domain and Creative-Commons''' films and shows, drawn from the Internet Archive.
* '''Free-to-air live TV''' channels, from the open iptv-org channel lists.
* '''Radio and podcasts''' as additional rows.
* '''On-MELEK video''' — the ScotTube feed of video posted on the chain itself.

== How it stays license-clear ==
Every asset is passed through a license router so that only content cleared for streaming is listed, and the player only embeds officially whitelisted sources. The surface extends the earlier "Tune In" shell into a full catalog with rows, search and a watch page.
